criteo.adjust_A: linear in f0..f11, separate slopes per arm
criteo.adjust_B: cross-fitted (2 folds by rid parity) additive model of f0..f11 cut at 20 quantile bins each, prediction used as one covariate

M2_peeking.reference: two-sided z at last snapshot p<0.05
M2_peeking.drop: zero variance in either arm at last snapshot

M3_aa_replay.assignment: Bernoulli(1/2) per user, exact via binomial + hypergeometric per day

M4_ratio.check: criteo conversion per visit: naive and delta SE equal

M5_segments.replicate: same sign and p<0.05 on the other 27 slices

headline_rule: largest calls changed per 100 decisions among M2, M4, M5; M1 reported as sample saved; M3 excluded (size set by number of looks)
